title: Minimal Product Sets in Finite Metacyclic Groups
summary: Minimum product-set problems ask how small a product of two subsets of prescribed cardinalities can be in a finite group. Although the problem is completely understood for finite abelian groups, exact results in the nonabelian setting are available only for particular classes. We determine the minimum product-set function $μ_G$ for every finite metacyclic group, without assuming that the relevant cyclic extension splits.
